name: The Back Room
tagline: Build a pizzeria into an empire
description: A career of days. Start with $40 and a small pizzeria that sells margherita and cola; every day is 12 minutes of shop and 10 minutes of night in the cellar. Money buys upgrades on the wall screen: toppings and drinks, the cellar, the mixer and its recipes, three blocks of the street, dealers who sell for you, a brick press. Ranks grow with everything you earn, three goals a day pay a bonus, and the end goal is to buy the whole block. Main menu and pause menu in the headset; the career is saved under the player's name at 08:00 and 00:00 and on Save and quit.
